description: Multi-link Jones investigation for the c_5 and c_6 coefficients in the τ_M asymptotic expansion. The simple alternating 'Kashiwara b^k / integer Jones at q=1' pattern from prop:q-beta-categorical-precision-ladder breaks at c_5 ≈ 0.154 (not a simple integer) and c_6 ≈ 18.1 (much larger than b³). This probe sweeps multi-link Jones candidates + structural rationals to identify the source.
auditOnly: PR #655 follow-up. The structural origin of c_5, c_6 is unresolved. Open R&D recorded for future investigation.
